name: Shiriuchi (Japan)
description: A light blue field charged at the centre with the Shiriuchi town emblem in green and white: a green lozenge bearing a white stylised letter S.
history: Municipal flag of Shiriuchi, a town in Hokkaido; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 1 October 1967.

features.role: Shiriuchi town emblem — a green lozenge bearing a white stylised letter S
